New York: Sotheby's expects more than $9 million for thirty watches that have never changed hands.

The top lot, a platinum Patek Philippe minute repeater, is estimated at $2.5-5 million, an auction debut. Most of the rest are Patek references retailed by Tiffany & Co., several double-signed and new to auction.

The Original Owner Collection sells at Sotheby's New York, 7 December.
